name: aad-stage0-probes-a
why: durable store for the Top-4 extension's recovered students and unit records (plans/top4_extension.json), d1's probe session and then d4's; US-TX-3 is the secure datacenter with storage support and L40S. A RunPod network volume serves one running pod at a time, so d2's overlapping probe session gets its own volume (logs/budget/decisions.md 2026-10-20, at most two sessions at once). 50 GB: each unit keeps about 2.5 GB (the student's 2.38 GB model, its records and generations), two sessions of 7 units about 35 GB

price_basis._note: a dated stated constant, prorated at 720 h/month (the dearer hourly rate)
